The Allied Solutions internship program is a robust and consistent internship program for rising Juniors and Seniors. The program will focus on learning and development as well as hands-on experience. The program will immerse the intern into a broad range of responsibilities, allowing you to execute projects within your area of professional interests.

Interested applicants must be available during the 12-week program (May 17th – Aug. 6th, 2027). This is a full-time internship (40-hours per week) based at our headquarters in Carmel, IN.

The Data Science Intern will join the Data Intelligence team and gain hands-on experience applying data, analytics, and AI to real business challenges. This role is designed for students interested in pursuing a career in Data Science and provides exposure to the full data lifecycle through structured rotations across Data Science, Data Engineering, Data Governance, and Data Analytics. The internship emphasizes developing analytical, statistical, and problem-solving skills while building an understanding of how enterprise data is collected, managed, governed, and transformed into actionable insights.

Job Duties and Responsibilities

- Assist with exploratory data analysis to identify patterns, trends, and actionable business insights.

- Support the development, testing, and evaluation of predictive models, machine learning solutions, and AI use cases.

- Prepare, cleanse, and transform data for analytical and Data Science applications.

- Create visualizations and presentations that communicate findings and recommendations to business stakeholders.

- Conduct research on emerging AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics techniques.

- Participate in a Data Engineering rotation focused on data pipelines, data integration, and modern data platform concepts (20%).

- Participate in a Data Governance rotation focused on data quality, stewardship, metadata management, and trusted data practices (15%).

- Participate in a Data Analytics rotation focused on reporting, dashboards, performance metrics, and business decision support (15%).

- Collaborate with Data Intelligence team members across multiple disciplines to understand the end-to-end data lifecycle.

- Present project outcomes and internship learnings to leadership and stakeholders.

- Perform other projects and analyses as assigned.

Qualifications (Education, Experience, Certifications & KSA)

- Currently enrolled in an undergraduate program as a rising Junior or Senior, pursuing a degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field.

- Foundational experience with Python, SQL, and data analysis concepts.

- Understanding statistics, analytical methods, or machine learning concepts.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.

- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

- Curiosity about AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, and emerging technologies.

- Interest in how organizations leverage data as a strategic asset.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

- Eagerness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, skills, efforts or working conditions associated with a job.

Business Unit/Role Specific Info

Global Commercial Services (GCS) serves millions of business customers around the world, from mom-and-pop shops to Fortune 500 companies. We back businesses so they can do more business, with a mission to be the undisputed leader in financial and membership services - responsibly driving double-digit revenue growth. We do that by offering a diverse range of payment and cashflow tools, from a wide range of traditional card products, to working capital and supply chain financing, to new digital solutions that make it easy for our customers to manage a full range of their financial and payment needs.

Responsibilities

How will you make an impact in this role?

We’re looking for graduate level interns to support the Global Commercial Services (GCS) product vision as a Product Development Intern. The successful candidate will own the product strategy for one of our commercial banking, cash flow management, or payments products. Product Managers at American Express play a central role identifying customer needs, building outstanding experiences, and leading teams to manage and market these products. This is a fast-paced team driving the development of commercial customer solutions at American Express.

As a GCS Product Development Intern, you will:

- Develop business cases for new products, features, and customer experiences.

- Shape product marketing strategies to drive customer engagement and new growth.

- Derive insights from the competitive landscape and customer feedback.

- Synthesize analytics and financials to develop data-driven recommendations, define success metrics, and evaluate product performance

- Support product development activities by documenting requirements, coordinating cross-functional deliverables, and maintaining product documentation and backlogs.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Marketing, Finance, Technology, Legal, Compliance, Design, and other stakeholders to support the development, launch, and enhancement of commercial products.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

- Currently enrolled in full-time graduate degree program.

- Graduate degree candidates with an expected graduation date between December 2027 and June 2028.

- 3 plus years of prior full-time work experience.

Preferred Qualifications

- Demonstrated interest in commercial payments, digital products, and product development.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to distill complex data and concepts into clear insights and recommendations.

- Intellectual curiosity and desire to continually learn about the evolving payments landscape and emerging technologies.

- Ability to collaborate with and build strong relationships with leaders, colleagues across different time zones, and cross-functional partners to deliver value.

- Strong project management skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with ability to present ideas clearly and concisely.

- Demonstrated resilience, proactive mindset, and a willingness to challenge the status quo and drive continuous improvement.

- Proficiency in analytical and presentation tools, including MS Excel and PowerPoint.

- Experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, etc.) to enhance research, analysis, problem solving, and productivity.

Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the United States is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions

About the company

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

- Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)

- Free and confidential counselling support through our Healthy Minds program

- Career development and training opportunities

The GCG Operations division supports the day-to-day operational needs of the Sales group in the areas of business insights, technology product management, intermediary relationships, client onboarding, reporting, and administrative support.

- Identify areas to improve data automation and partner with colleagues to implement solutions
- Proactively communicate needs, challenges, and capacity
- Develop a robust understanding of Dimensional’s investment philosophy and process

- Minimum GPA of 3.2; pursuing an undergraduate or specialized Master’s degree with an expected graduation date of December 2027 - June 2028
- Coursework in information systems, computer science, or finance/accounting is preferred
- Demonstrated interest in helping sales teams make process-driven, data-informed decisions
- Documented analytical and quantitative skills
- Ability to gather requirements amid ambiguity
- Interpersonal communication, verbal, and written skills

- Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills

Tech & Data Program Summer 2027 – Software Engineer Intern

Program Overview

At The Hartford, we foster an inclusive and collaborative environment where every voice is valued and every idea can make an impact. Our culture is built on integrity, innovation, and a customer-first mindset. We believe in empowering employees through continuous learning, mentorship, meaningful work, and opportunities to solve real business challenges.

As a Software Engineer Intern, you will help design, build, test, and enhance applications that support our customers, employees, and business operations. You'll work alongside experienced engineers in a collaborative Agile environment, applying modern software development practices to create solutions that deliver measurable business value.

Bring your curiosity, technical mindset, and willingness to learn. Your voice and perspective matter here.

As part of The Hartford’s growing investment in AI and advanced technologies, interns will gain exposure to emerging capabilities such as generative AI, machine learning, and intelligent automation while contributing to meaningful projects that support business and customer outcomes.

- Apply technical and analytical problem-solving skills to improve application performance, security, and customer experiences, and present outcomes to stakeholders.

- Strong communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills
- Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies and challenge assumptions
- Ability to analyze complex problems and develop practical technical solutions
- Commitment to ethical decision-making and responsible technology practices

Are you looking for an exciting job where you can put your skills and talents to work at a company you can feel proud to be a part of? Do you want a workplace that will challenge you and offer you opportunities to learn and grow? A position at Xcel Energy could be just what you’re looking for.

At Xcel Energy, our employees are the driving force behind our success. So we make sure that, here, you can be your best. Doing work that makes a difference for neighbors and communities. Working with a team you can count on to push you. Expanding skills, staying ready for change, and capturing opportunities to grow. All with the support, rewards and recognition you need to thrive – during your internship and beyond.

Xcel Energy is seeking candidates to support our Damage Prevention Organization. The paid internship provides an opportunity to showcase your abilities in our Damage Prevention group that supports various business units throughout the company. The program provides practical work experience to develop your existing skillset, present to senior leadership, and collaborate with key internal stakeholders. Each intern will be relied upon to play a role in achieving department objectives and goals. The program will allow you to apply what you’ve learned in school and further enhance your knowledge through hands-on training and provide opportunities to network and learn with other interns across the Gas organization.

Typical intern responsibilities may include but are not limited to:

- Participate in the monthly financial review/reporting process.

- Assist with Damage Prevention Investigations.

- Excavator outreach and education.

- Assist with updates, data maintenance, and analysis.

This position is for a May 24, 2027 start date. This position may have the possibility to extend beyond the internship’s initial term based on the candidate’s successful performance and Xcel Energy’s business needs.

Minimum Requirements:

- Current student, Freshman or higher

- Enrolled in an accredited college or university and pursuing a degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, and/or MIS/Computer Science/ Data Analytics

- Driver License and personal vehicle

- Able to work full-time during the summer (up to 40 hours a week)/ part time during the school year (up to 20 hours a week) and commuting to the designated work location in-person, per our hybrid work policy.

Preferred Qualifications:

- 3.0 GPA (out of a 4.0 scale) or higher

- Completed 2 years of undergraduate coursework
